title: Git Bisect: Find the Commit That Broke Your Code
description:
Which commit broke your code? Let git find it for you! 🔍

✅ Mark HEAD as bad and v1.0 as good with git bisect start
✅ Run git bisect run dotnet test to test every step automatically
✅ Paste the bad commit's diff to AI and ask why it broke

Day 3 of AI Debugging. Next up: Day 4, Add Logging That Finds the Bug.
Follow for a new short every day and learn to debug with AI the right way.

comment: Bisect or guessing: which would you try first? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: when you finish, run git bisect reset to get back to your original branch.
